Here's a look at how much SNOW typically falls across the United States every winter! ❄️

This year has a lot of moving pieces with El Niño in play, so some of you could blow right past these numbers while others won’t come close.

Talk about some UNUSUAL November weather... Buffalo, New York is WARMER than Dallas, Texas!

Buffalo reached 78°F today, while Dallas has only climbed to 75°F!

That 78°F reading in Buffalo is a preliminary RECORD HIGH for November 4th.
